Merge feat/kernel-capabilities-0927: P4 switch capabilities on get_graph_data nodes

Each bmv2 switch node carries the capabilities object the proxy serves on GET /p4/switch_state, copied verbatim and absent whenever the kernel has nothing to copy. head_commit.message:
Merge feat/ndt-serve-gui-0927 (opus judge MERGE on 8c3047c7, after MERGE AFTER FIXES on fcd4f69a): ndt serve serves its own page

Adam's ruling H (2026-09-27): the GUI is a static page that ndt serve itself serves at /, /app.js and /app.css, same origin, no CORS. The token reaches the page through a one-time key in the URL fragment that serve prints at start (POST /session, Origin required to be this very origin, good once, --nonce-ttl s, 8 newest only); the page drops the fragment from the address bar as soon as it has read it. New reads GET /lab (plain status plus the claim, measuring and declared rows verbatim, claim_is_yours, measuring_is_nothing, busy) and GET /meta. dry_run is accepted only on writes that spawn, and returns the argv without running it. The confirmation strength per write is the server's confirm_policy; the page adds only the measuring rule. The job log is read every 2 s and stops when the job ends, when the view is closed, and while the page is hidden.

Judge B1 (fcd4f69a): an app start/stop under somebody else's claim was refused only by the page -- ndt's apps verbs check no claim -- so w_app now reads the claim inside the slot (_require_own_claim, 409 claim for another owner, none, stale or a `yours-x` owner); the preview still needs no claim. G-N1, G-N7, G-N8, G-N17 and the REPORT's numbers are fixed in the same round.

Test merge d09a4f17 (7746832e + 8c3047c7, tree aba2f7c7, this merge's): test_ndt_serve 74 OK, test_ndt_serve_cells 35 OK, test_ndt_serve_gui 40 OK, tests/browser/test_ndt_serve_page 5 OK under the guard and 5 skipped outside it, mutate_ndt_serve 150/0, mutate_ndt_serve_page 5/0, check_gate_anchors 122/122, check_process_by_name and check_test_tmpdirs clean, tripwire 0, tracked tree clean after the gates. Queued after this merge, on a branch of its own: test_claim_note_reaches_ndt_as_one_argv_element goes red under a TMPDIR longer than about 55 characters (a note built from two absolute temp paths against a 200-character cap).

[Co-developed with claude code -- Adam]
